description: This file defines the RequestResponseClient interface in the org.eclipse.hono.client package, outlining methods for managing request-response communication in an AMQP client context, including closing links, checking connection status, and setting request timeout.

classes.name: RequestResponseClient
classes.description: Interface for common methods that all clients following the request-response pattern need to implement, extending CreditBasedSender.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link(s) with the Hono server this client is configured to use; uses a Handler<AsyncResult<Void>> to handle completion.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if this client's sender and receiver are (locally) open, returning true if usable for message exchange.

methods.name: setRequestTimeout
methods.description: Sets the period after which requests are considered timed out; throws IllegalArgumentException if the value is negative.
